crossRefs.note: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon…
John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come…
I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle…
He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write…
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God.
How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice. Righteousness lodged in her, but now there are…

Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Yet again they will use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities…
For he looked for the city which has the foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable…
For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out…
For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her…
But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his…
It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen: for the fine linen is the righteous acts…
Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
For your Maker is your husband; Yahweh of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be…
I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of…
You will not be called Forsaken any more, nor will your land be called Desolate any more; but you will be called…
He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly…
For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I married you to one husband, that I might present you as a pure…
Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;
because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
translations.bsb: I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
translations.kjv: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
translations.asv: And I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven of God, made ready as a bride adorned for her husband.
